title: Update Graphql Schema to Match Ts
description: The GraphQL schema (compose/graphql/schema.graphql) is severely outdated compared to the TypeScript reference implementation (compose/js/index.ts). Missing: guid-based IDs, DiffStatus enum, Diff types for all entities, Meta/Shallow types, Change types, new entities (Port, Prop, Quality, Benchmark, Tag, Concept, File, Folder, Layer, Group, Stat, Vec, Camera), new fields on existing entities (parent, isAbstract, folder, props, scale, mirrorPlane, isHidden, isLocked, color, name on Piece/Connector, designPiece on Side, canScale, canMirror, activeLayer, stats, layers, groups on Design, etc.), collection diff patterns (removed/updated/added). The schema needs to be completely rewritten to match the TS source of truth.
summary: Completely rewrote compose/graphql/schema.graphql to match the TypeScript reference implementation (compose/js/index.ts). The old schema was severely outdated with name/variant-based IDs, missing entities, and no diff/meta/shallow support. The new schema (2306 lines) includes: 1 scalar (DateTime), 1 enum (DiffStatus), 162 output types, 107 input types. Covers all entities: Attribute, Location, Author, File, Folder, Benchmark, Quality, Port, Prop, Tag, Concept, Model, Connector, Type, Layer, Piece, Group, Side, Connection, Stat, Design, Kit. Each entity has full/Meta/Shallow variants where applicable. All Diff types with collection diff patterns (removed/updated/added). Value types: Coord, Vec, Point, Vector, Plane, Camera with their diffs. Change types: KitChange, DesignChange. All ID types use guid-based references. Complete input type mirrors for mutations.
